entities.summary: Harry Everett Mitchell is an American politician and educator who served as a U.S. representative representing Arizona's 5th congressional district from 2007 until 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Harry Mitchell was a writers & intellectuals from Phoenix (b. 1940-07-18, Phoenix). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
